C_notes.support_tickets: DEFENDED: WITH CHECK pins status, priority, assigned_to, resolved_at. Pattern to copy.
C_notes.reports: GAP: INSERT policy pins only reporter_id, so a reporter can choose status on insert (default open). Candidate for a column grant or a pinned WITH CHECK in SEC-003.
C_notes.conversation_members: DEFENDED (in set B): WITH CHECK re-selects the row and pins role and status. Reference pattern.
C_notes.profiles: Already hardened in R2.0.1 -- 6 owner-editable UPDATE columns only.

D_notes.TYPES: No pg_default_acl entry for TYPES in schema public under either owner -- PostgreSQL defaults apply (USAGE to PUBLIC). Stated explicitly rather than omitted.
D_notes.root_cause: supabase_admin grants arwdDxtm on TABLES and X on FUNCTIONS to anon+authenticated for every new object; postgres grants only Dxtm on TABLES and nothing on FUNCTIONS. Hosted objects inherit supabase_admins default, local ones inherit postgres. SEC-001 came from the FUNCTIONS row; SEC-002 and SEC-003 from the TABLES row.
D_notes.sequences: Both owners grant write on sequences to browser roles (rwU hosted, w local). Not yet audited.
